Positive factor pairs of 8 give (1,8), (2,4), (4,2), (8,1), so the sides are (5,12), (6,8), (8,6), (12,5). Negative pairs would need a-4 and b-4 both negative with product 8, so a-4 ≥ -3, which gives (-1,-8), (-2,-4) and so on. These produce b-4 ≤ -4, meaning b ≤ 0, which is invalid. With unordered rectangles there are 2 of them: 5×12 and 6×8.

To make it a bit more interesting, I ask for the sum of the areas of all such rectangles, counting unordered shapes once. The areas are 60 and 48, so the sum is 108.

The solver loops over a ≤ b up to 100, checks a*b == 2*(a+b), and sums a*b.
